data.name: Phantom Containment
data.detailed_description:
📚 A Living Archive of Anomalies

Phantom Containment is built around a growing archive of entities, aberrant species, anomalies, and forgotten civilizations discovered throughout Helix Planet.

The long-term vision is an expansive and evolving bestiary that continues to grow over time, introducing new species, entity classes, anomaly types, and ancient mysteries as the world expands.

🧬 Origin Unknown 🧬

Every entity has a place within the greater universe.

Some are remnants of extinct civilizations.

Some are failed experiments abandoned by their creators.

Others originate from regions of reality that were never meant to intersect.

Each discovery contributes to a larger mystery surrounding Helix Planet and the forces that shaped it.

🔬 Investigation Before Confrontation 🔬

Every encounter is more than a fight for survival.

It is an opportunity to learn.

Entities feature:

Unique behaviors and adaptations

Detailed research logs and classifications

Environmental interactions

Hidden origins and lore

Distinct strengths and weaknesses

Studying an entity may reveal information that cannot be discovered through combat alone.

You are not simply hunting the unknown.

You are documenting it.

📖 Build Your Archive📖

Recover samples, artifacts, records, and research data to expand your personal archive.

Over time, your discoveries will reveal the history of Helix Plant, the civilizations that once controlled it, and the countless entities left behind.

The deeper your knowledge grows, the closer you come to understanding the true purpose of the experiment.


Roadmap

Roadmap Information

The roadmap represents the planned features and content that are intended to be implemented before the game reaches Version 1.0.

These features define the current development goals for Early Access and serve as the foundation for the full release. The roadmap image is intended to show the overall scope of planned additions and should not be interpreted as a release schedule or priority list. Features shown may be developed and released in any order as development progresses.

As with any active game in development, priorities may change based on testing, technical requirements, community feedback, and the overall health of the project. While every effort will be made to deliver the features listed, adjustments may be necessary to ensure the best possible experience.

Once the game reaches Version 1.0, this roadmap will be considered complete. A new post-launch roadmap will then be published, outlining future content, expansions, gameplay improvements, and long-term support planned for the game beyond its full release.

Important: The roadmap image displays features planned for development in no particular order. It is intended to communicate the planned scope of the game rather than the sequence in which features will be released.


About the Game

Survive the Experiment.

Phantom Containment is an open-world anomaly survival horror game set on Helix Planet, a massive containment world consumed by hostile entities, aberrant species, anomaly outbreaks, and violent factions.

You are not a hero.
You are a specimen.

Trapped inside a classified experiment alongside thousands of prisoners, exiles, scavengers, zealots, failed experiments, and hostile survivor groups, your only goal is survival.

Escape is impossible.

To the civilizations beyond the stars, everyone inside Helix Planet is expendable.

Scavenge what you can.
Build what you must.
And survive long enough to uncover what Helix Plant was truly built for.

🌍 A Massive Living Containment World 🌍

Explore a huge open world filled with:

abandoned research complexes

ruined settlements

underground bunkers

corrupted wilderness

anomaly zones

aberrant species territories

hidden laboratories

containment facilities

forgotten ruins

The world evolves throughout development with expanding regions, new biomes, environmental systems, entities, and survival threats.

Each biome introduces unique:

  • anomalous activity

  • environmental hazards

  • resources

  • weather conditions

  • entities

  • aberrant species

  • survival challenges

What feels calm during the day may become deadly after dark.

The world constantly changes through:

  • dynamic weather

  • anomaly storms

  • roaming entities

  • containment sweeps

  • faction raids

  • territorial conflict

  • containment breaches

No area stays safe forever.

👁️ Planet Is Alive 👁️

Anomalies are not limited to scripted encounters.

They exist everywhere.

Different regions of the Plant are influenced by powerful entities and unknown forces that react to:

  • noise

  • structures

  • lights

  • player activity

  • stored artifacts

  • territorial expansion

You may:

hear voices from empty structures

see distant figures observing your movements

experience hallucinations and reality distortions

attract hostile entities to your settlement

discover signs that something entered your shelter during the night

Build in the wrong territory —
and your settlement may become part of the hunt.

Nowhere is completely safe.

🔦 Investigation & Containment 🔦

Detection and containment equipment are essential tools for survival.

Use specialized equipment to:

  • detect nearby anomalies

  • identify hostile entities

  • track aberrant species

  • stabilize dangerous areas

  • secure your settlement

  • recover anomalous artifacts

  • survive entity encounters

Prepare your defenses using:

protective devices

containment tools

anomaly scanners

traps

containment systems

environmental monitoring equipment

Knowledge is often more valuable than weapons.

⚒️ Build, Expand & Defend ⚒️

Gather resources, hunt wildlife, craft equipment, and build shelters ranging from improvised camps to heavily fortified survival compounds.

Expand your base with:

  • crafting stations

  • storage systems

  • farms

  • workshops

  • defensive walls

  • power systems

  • containment chambers

  • research facilities

But large settlements attract attention.

Hostile factions, containment forces, scavenger groups, zealots, and anomalous entities may raid your territory to destroy structures, recover artifacts, or eliminate survivors.

If your defenses fail, you may lose:

supplies

equipment

territory

and parts of your settlement

Survival means constantly rebuilding.

⚔️ Other Survivors Are Just As Dangerous ⚔️

You are not alone on Helix Planet.

Encounter:

  • hostile prisoner factions

  • scavenger groups

  • rogue survivors

  • zealot factions

  • containment operatives

  • corrupted individuals

  • escaped experiments

Some fight for survival.
Others fight for power.

As the Planet descends deeper into chaos, conflict between survivors becomes unavoidable.

Choose how you survive:

stealth and evasion

direct combat

traps and defenses

scavenging

containment tactics

strategic preparation

Overconfidence gets people killed.

📈 Survival, Skills & Progression 📈

Develop your survivor through long-term progression and skill-based gameplay.

Train abilities including:

  • mining

  • woodcutting

  • fishing

  • farming

  • cooking

  • tailoring

  • construction

  • stealth

  • lockpicking

  • hunting

  • crafting

  • combat

  • alchemy

and more

Manage critical survival systems such as:

hunger

energy

temperature

oxygen

inventory weight

environmental hazards

anomaly exposure

Every decision affects your chances of survival.

📚 Uncover the Truth 📚

Hidden across Helix Planet are the remains of failed containment operations, abandoned experiments, collapsed facilities, and forgotten civilizations.

Recover:

anomalous artifacts

entity samples

experimental technology

ancient relics

classified records

containment logs

research archives

The deeper you explore, the clearer the truth becomes:

The Planet was never built as a prison.

It was never built to contain anomalies.

It was built to determine which species could survive them.

And the experiment is still ongoing.

  • Storage: 50 GB available space

  • Storage: 60 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains mature themes associated with survival horror and supernatural conflict.

Players will encounter violent situations involving hostile entities and human factions. Combat includes the use of weapons and survival tools against enemies, with accompanying visual effects such as blood and damage impacts.

The game features horror elements including disturbing environments, psychological tension, and encounters with anomalous or non-human entities. Players may experience unsettling imagery, sudden threats, and situations designed to create fear and suspense.

Themes of corruption, containment experimentation, and ritualistic or anomalous phenomena are present throughout the game world.

The game does not contain sexual content, sexual violence, or depictions of drug or alcohol abuse as core themes.

Some players may find the overall atmosphere, creature design, and narrative themes disturbing.
